verdict.rationale: Appwrite is a backend-as-a-service platform, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is the wrong product role. The evidence shows only that Appwrite publishes its own MCP server for external agents such as Claude Code and Cursor, which is the separate server-side story and cannot be credited here. Nothing shows Appwrite itself acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
